name: Atominvest MCP
description: Connect Claude to your Atominvest platform to query Portfolio Management or Investor Relations data, including portfolio company metrics, investor data, and fund commitments, directly from your conversation. Retrieve financial KPIs such as revenue, EBITDA, and debt for portfolio assets across any reporting period, look up investor accounts and their associated entities, and get detailed commitment breakdowns across funds, including amounts and statuses, all without leaving Claude. Ideal for portfolio managers and investor relations teams who need fast, conversational access to their Atominvest data to support reporting, investor queries, and portfolio monitoring.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Atominvest MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Atominvest MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.atominvest.co/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Atominvest MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Atominvest MCP lists 24 MCP tools, including get_account, get_asset_details, get_commitment, get_company, get_dataroom_activity, get_dataroom_permissions, get_entity, get_investment, get_investment_schedule, get_investment_transactions, get_metric, and get_metric_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Atominvest MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Atominvest MCP in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Atominvest MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Atominvest MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Atominvest MCP is developed by Atominvest. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
